name: gremio-ifce-firebase-tests
description: Testes de segurança do Firestore no emulador, sem dados reais

scripts.test:rules: firebase emulators:exec --project demo-gremio-ifce --only firestore "node --test tests/firestore.test.cjs tests/ifce-eventos-v2.test.cjs"
scripts.test:ui: node --test tests/navegacao.test.cjs tests/primeira-experiencia.test.cjs tests/central-implantacao.test.cjs tests/modo-demonstracao.test.cjs tests/verificador-seguranca.test.cjs tests/portal-eventos-offline.test.cjs tests/ifce-seguranca-eventos-mobile.test.cjs
scripts.test:template:rules: firebase emulators:exec --config template-escolas/firebase.json --project demo-gremio-escola-teste --only firestore "node --test tests/template-escolas.rules.test.cjs"
scripts.test:privacy:backend: node --check functions/index.js && node --check functions/event-service.cjs && node --check functions/release-gate.cjs && node --test tests/ifce-events-release.test.cjs
